# Guru Bhajan Singh

> MERN Stack Developer (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js) and WordPress expert with 7+ years of full-stack web development experience. Also familiar with PHP, Laravel and CodeIgniter.

## Summary
Guru Bhajan Singh is a Sr. Web Developer based in Noida, India, currently working at CloudThat Technologies Pvt. Ltd. He specializes in the MERN stack and recently built an AI Receptionist application end-to-end (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js). He has 7+ years of experience, 200+ completed projects, and has previously worked at Cross Section Interactive, MateBiz, Gartndev Web Studios, and Benzaitens Group.
